recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white photograph of a male performer in a high-collared, studded white jumpsuit, captured mid-performance against a dark, out-of-focus stage background. The composition is framed by vibrant yellow script typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast white costume against a deep black negative space background
Vibrant yellow primary text contrasting with the monochrome photographic base
Vertical alignment of the performer's studded jumpsuit placket with the central axis
Dynamic diagonal line created by the performer's arm holding a microphone
coreInvariants: High-collared white jumpsuit with metallic stud detailing
Grainy, high-contrast black and white photographic texture
Dark, atmospheric stage background with bokeh light artifacts

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-long shot of the performer, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The performer's face and the high-contrast white collar area.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright yellow text at the top, moves down to the performer's face, follows the arm to the microphone, and descends the vertical line of the jumpsuit studs.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space in the upper corners and background creates a spotlight effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white monochrome for the photographic subject.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the background to push the subject forward.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright lemon yellow for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between the white suit and black background; high saturation only in the header text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Formal copperplate script and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary script features high stroke contrast with elegant loops on capitals
Secondary script is a tighter, slanted cursive
Corner metadata uses a geometric, heavy sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital 'E' features a large, sweeping top flourish
Lowercase 'l' and 'v' are tightly connected with fluid ligatures
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Formal script for the name paired with a lighter, more informal cursive for the subtitle, anchored by heavy sans-serif technical data in the corners.

avoid: Modern digital sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant loops of the primary name text.
Provides the necessary formal calligraphic feel for the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of a 1970s male singer in a white studded jumpsuit with a high collar, holding a microphone on a dark stage with visible film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a large yellow copperplate script at the top left and right. Place the subtitle in a smaller white cursive in the center top. Add technical block text in the top corners in a white sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the jumpsuit white and highly detailed with studs?
Is the background predominantly black with stage lighting artifacts?
Is the primary text a vibrant yellow script?
Is the overall image grain consistent with 1970s film?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the corners
Exact facial features of the original performer
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast separation between subject and background
Ensure the yellow text is legible and vibrant
Verify the jumpsuit collar is prominent and structured
Confirm the presence of 1970s-style film grain
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W stage photography + Top-aligned vibrant yellow script + 70s costume detail.
